Rest breaks on a tiring season
This part of the manual describes what is expected

Companion Animal Travel Desk Policy for Animal Care and Passenger Support

Purpose: This section sets the standard for humane, prompt, and accountable handling of companion animals so travelers receive clear support and every animal remains safe, calm, and observed.

Staff must treat every report of distress as urgent and must act without delay to reduce fear, noise, heat, and handling pressure. The welfare coordinator reviews comfort needs before acceptance, and the cabin team monitors animals during flight with steady attention and prompt handoffs. When a traveler raises a concern, staff must listen fully, document the issue in plain language, and move to a practical remedy rather than offering vague reassurance. If a kennel, carrier, lounge, or relief area does not meet the need of the animal, the desk must escalate at once and protect the traveler from repeated transfers.

At Port Isolde, the quarantine room must be used only in accordance with the active animal-care plan, and staff must confirm that the traveler is guided to the correct check-in path before any animal is left there. <<FACT F027>> The desk must not promise a substitute space unless it has been verified by the relevant station team, and no animal may be left waiting in a public area while staff seek approval. The pet lounge must remain clean, supervised, and accessible to animals whose condition requires quiet rest, and any delay in access must be explained in direct terms with a repair plan. <<FACT F003>> Travelers should never be left to guess where support is available, and staff must remain visible until the handoff is complete.

At Ashenfell, the pet relief area must be opened and used only through the approved access procedure, and staff must confirm safe entry before directing any traveler there. <<FACT F018>> If a pet is agitated, staff should slow the process, reduce surrounding traffic, and offer the most humane available option without argument. No member of the desk may dismiss a welfare concern as minor when an animal is clearly unsettled.

Any employee who cannot verify a safe arrangement must immediately notify the senior coordinator and the duty supervisor, and the Companion Animal Travel Desk must be contacted at once for further action.
